messages:
ryan-sales: Heads up — Acme POC seeing slow TTFT and intermittent 429s since noon. Carla says latency spikes to 600-900ms per TTFT. Can we swarm?

carla-customer: Confirmed. Native app sends many tiny prompts (avg 8 tokens). Also seeing cache_miss spikes in console. Roughly 20% cache hit.

alice-support: Investigating. Can you share request pattern sample and SDK config? Also any logs with 429s?

carla-customer: here's a snippet of the client loop:
```
for msg in messages:
  ri.client.generate(prompt=msg)
```
No batching.

ingrid-se: aha — client isn't batching. Small requests kill batching efficiency & prefix cache. That explains cache_miss + throughput.

ben-ops: Also seeing logs on our side:
```
[2025-03-10T12:03:02Z] 429 ERR_RATE_LIMIT route=hosted region=us-west model=redwood-v1 req_id=abc123
[2025-03-10T12:03:02Z] ttft=0.85s tokens=12 batch_size=1 cache_hit=false
[2025-03-10T12:03:03Z] 200 ttft=0.92s tokens=9 batch_size=1 cache_hit=false
```

alice-support: Exactly — many size-1 batches. Recommend client-side coalescing or use SDK streaming batch helper. Quick test: set SDK `max_batch_tokens=256` and `batch_timeout_ms=25`.

ryan-sales: Quick pricing q: will increasing batch timeout affect cost for POC? They worry about per-token pricing spikes if we hold tokens.

ingrid-se: Cost doesn't increase by timeout directly — batching reduces overall tokens per-second cost by amortizing model overhead. It might slightly increase latency tail for single interactive requests, but TTFT should drop.

carla-customer: Can you provide the exact config we should try? We can change now.

alice-support: Try:
```
client = RIClient(
  model=\"redwood-v1\",
  batching={\"max_batch_tokens\":256, \"max_batch_size\":16, \"batch_timeout_ms\":25},
  cache={\"enabled\":true, \"prefix_cache\":true}
)
```
Also enable `kv_cache=true` in deployment if not already.

ben-ops: Note: their account currently on hosted free tier with low burst quota. 429s are from quota throttle. I increased temporary burst to 2x for this POC — watch for invoices.

carla-customer: Applying config now.

carla-customer: Results — TTFT median down to 220ms, 95th 480ms, cache_hit now 74%. 429s gone.

ryan-sales: Amazing. Any follow-ups for production (Dedicated/Private)?

ingrid-se: For production: (1) move to Dedicated for steady throughput and higher burst, (2) recommend client batching by default or use our SDK's batcher, (3) prewarm prefix cache for common prompts, (4) quantized model variant for cost.

ryan-sales: I'll send a quick summary to Acme + pricing delta options. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deployment change: temporary burst increased for account acme-poc by support at 2025-03-10T12:10:12Z — ticket #7891

carla-customer: thanks everyone. Will loop in infra for Dedicated decision.

alice-support: closing loop — reopen if regressions. :raised_hands:
